integrity: The proof independently derives the regular spherical vertex-radius relation, proves the curved body's circumradius by combining a vertex-average lower bound, an explicit inner-ball inclusion, and Hou--Jin's inradius-plus-circumradius identity, then substitutes into their asymmetry definition. A standalone verifier checks the geometric identities and asymptotics over a finite grid without using that grid as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats Lassak's regular spherical Reuleaux odd-gons in the constant-width regime 0<omega<=pi/2. It does not classify irregular spherical Reuleaux polygons or widths above pi/2. The identical Euclidean formula is prior work; originality is claimed only for the spherical width-independent profile and its proof.
title: Width-independent spherical Minkowski asymmetry of regular Reuleaux odd-gons
